name: ai.globalway/globalway
title: GlobalWay (出海通)
description: Guides for brands selling overseas via creators, plus creator post price and budget reach estimates.

tools.name: search_guides
tools.description: Search GlobalWay’s guides for brands selling abroad and the creators they work with: sponsorship prices on YouTube, Instagram and X, finding creators, selling without an overseas store, Amazon Brand Registry and Attribution, and more. Returns the best matches, each with its title, summary and page URL; get_guide returns the full text.

query.description: The question or keywords, in English or Chinese.

locale.description: Language of the results. Defaults to the language of the query.

tools.name: list_guides
tools.description: List every GlobalWay guide with its summary and link.

tools.name: get_guide
tools.description: The full text of one guide as Markdown, with its source URL and review date at the end. Prices in it come from the same tables the site’s estimators use.

tools.name: list_niches
tools.description: The content niches (IAB category ids) the estimators price by, with English and Chinese names.

tools.name: estimate_post_price
tools.description: Advisory price range for one sponsored post on a YouTube, X or Instagram channel, from its reach and niche, using GlobalWay’s per-1,000 rates. "brand_pays" includes the platform fee; "creator_receives" is the creator’s share. An estimate, not a quote. For a real channel, the free estimator at the returned URL reads its public stats.

avg_views.description: YouTube: average views per recent video. X: average impressions per post. Not used for Instagram.

followers.description: Instagram: follower count (required). X: used only if avg_views is missing.

niche.description: IAB category id from list_niches, e.g. "IAB-9". Omit for the platform average.

tools.name: estimate_budget_reach
tools.description: For a per-post budget in USD, roughly how many views (YouTube), impressions (X) or followers of the account booked (Instagram) it buys, at GlobalWay’s rates. Advisory.

niche.description: IAB category id from list_niches. Omit for the platform average.
